g.text: 1. user should be able to view aggregated feed of news articles from thousands
of source publishers around the world
2. user should be able to scroll through the feed (infinity)
3. user should be able to click on articles and redirected to the publishers webstie
(user would prefer slight outed news then no content)
2. system should be scable to handle 100m DAU and spike upto 500m users
2. Article - core content entity (news article) , having attributes
like : publisher name , publishing date , region, thumbnail url , media url
3. Publisher - reperesents the news source , with attributes like
3.does not require an api endpoint for this
when a user clicks on the url provided in the article browser will redirect to the publishers website
RSS is a simple XML format that allows publishers to
syndicate their content to other websites and readers.
1. queries the database for the list of publishers and their RSS feed URLs
2.Extract all content , metadata, and downloads media files
3.Stores thumbnail files in Object Storage and saves article data with media URLs to the Database
why not just point directly to the url of the source image hosted by the publisher rather than going
through all the effort to download it and store it in our own Object Storage?
-serve the images to users quickly and efficiently, and not rely on the publisher's servers
which may be slow, overloaded, or go down entirely.

Database query fetches articles with OFFSET and LIMIT clauses
issue : With traditional page-based pagination user might see duplicate
solution: monotonically incresing articleid - use article id as cursor
polling publisher RSS feeds every 3-6 hours
note 5: For infrequent publisers or which don't provide RSS feeds
we need to implement web scraping that programmatically visits news websites and extracts new
articles directly from their HTML structure. Our scraping system maintains a database of website
patterns and CSS selectors for identifying article content on major news sites.
